description: SAINT PAUL, Minn. – On Wednesday, November 19, Rep. Cheryl Youakim (DFL – Hopkins) and Rep. title: Reps. Youakim and Kraft partner with STEP for Holiday Food Drive on Nov. 19 - Youakim for State Representative
